`aitt` is the command-line tool inside the app (`~/.local/bin/aitt` links to it). `aitt` with no command prints:

```text
Usage: aitt <command>   (AI Task Tracking)
  serve            run the HTTP server on the data folder (AITT_HOME, default ~/AITaskTracking)
  mcp              stdio MCP proxy
  setup            first-run setup: data folder, first project, backup, Claude Code (setup --help)
  open <ID|slug>   show an issue or project in the app (browser if the app isn't installed): aitt open ATT-1
  docs             open the user docs the engine serves (http://127.0.0.1:<port>/docs/) in the browser
  guidance         print the agent instructions for other tools (--cursor: as a .cursor/rules/*.mdc file)
  uninstall        remove the app, its login item, link, skill and MCP entries; keeps the data (--yes: don't ask)
  bench <n>        time open/snapshot/search on n synthetic issues
  --version        print the version
```

## aitt serve

Run the HTTP server on the data folder (AITT_HOME, default ~/AITaskTracking).

```sh
aitt serve
```

## aitt mcp

Stdio MCP proxy.

```sh
aitt mcp
```

## aitt setup

First-run setup: data folder, first project, backup, Claude Code (setup --help).

```text
Usage: aitt setup [options]
Sets up AI Task Tracking: a data folder and Claude Code. Asks on a terminal; --yes takes every default.
  --yes, -y               no questions (defaults: no backup, no CLAUDE.md line)
  --home <dir>            data folder (default: $AITT_HOME or ~/AITaskTracking)
  --project <name>        first project, e.g. your team (only when the folder has no projects)
  --backup <owner/name>   back up to a new private GitHub repo (needs gh); --no-backup to skip
  --no-link               don't link ~/.local/bin/aitt to the app's binary
  --no-mcp                don't register the ai-task-tracking MCP server with Claude Code
  --no-skill              don't install the agent skill into ~/.claude/skills/ai-task-tracking
  --connect <tools>       connect other agent tools, comma-separated: codex,chatgpt,cursor,vscode,windsurf,gemini,claude-desktop
                          (default: every detected one); --no-connect to skip
  --claude-md             add the AI Task Tracking line to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; --no-claude-md to skip
  --binary <path>         aitt binary to register (default: this one, when it is the app's)
```

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--yes, -y` | no questions (defaults: no backup, no CLAUDE.md line) |
| `--home <dir>` | data folder (default: $AITT_HOME or ~/AITaskTracking) |
| `--project <name>` | first project, e.g. your team (only when the folder has no projects) |
| `--backup <owner/name>` | back up to a new private GitHub repo (needs gh); --no-backup to skip |
| `--no-link` | don't link ~/.local/bin/aitt to the app's binary |
| `--no-mcp` | don't register the ai-task-tracking MCP server with Claude Code |
| `--no-skill` | don't install the agent skill into ~/.claude/skills/ai-task-tracking |
| `--connect <tools>` | connect other agent tools, comma-separated: codex,chatgpt,cursor,vscode,windsurf,gemini,claude-desktop (default: every detected one); --no-connect to skip |
| `--claude-md` | add the AI Task Tracking line to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; --no-claude-md to skip |
| `--binary <path>` | aitt binary to register (default: this one, when it is the app's) |

## aitt open

Show an issue or project in the app (browser if the app isn't installed): aitt open ATT-1.

```text
Usage: aitt open <ID | project-slug | link>
  aitt open ATT-1                  an issue
  aitt open website                a project (project/<slug> when the slug looks like an id, e.g. project/phase-2)
  aitt open aitt://issue/ATT-1     an app link, or a http://127.0.0.1:<port>/#/… link from a tool result
```

## aitt docs

Open the user docs the engine serves (http://127.0.0.1:&lt;port&gt;/docs/) in the browser.

```text
usage: aitt docs
```

## aitt guidance

Print the agent instructions for other tools (--cursor: as a .cursor/rules/*.mdc file).

```text
usage: aitt guidance [--cursor]
```

## aitt uninstall

Remove the app, its login item, link, skill and MCP entries; keeps the data (--yes: don't ask).

```text
Usage: aitt uninstall [--yes] [--app <path>]
Removes AI Task Tracking from this Mac: the app, its login item, and the MCP entries and ~/.local/bin/aitt link that
run this app; the agent skill and the CLAUDE.md line too, unless another install stays registered. Your data folder
is kept. Asks first unless --yes.
  --app <path>   the app bundle to remove (default: the one this aitt is in, else ~/Applications/AI Task Tracking.app).
                 Must be named AI Task Tracking.app and have its engine inside; never a folder that
                 holds your home or data folder.
```

| Flag | What it does |
|---|---|
| `--app <path>` | the app bundle to remove (default: the one this aitt is in, else ~/Applications/AI Task Tracking.app). Must be named AI Task Tracking.app and have its engine inside; never a folder that holds your home or data folder. |

## aitt bench

Time open/snapshot/search on n synthetic issues.

```text
usage: aitt bench <n>
```

## aitt --version

Print the version.

```sh
aitt --version
```
